backend: ClickStack 2.47.0 native OpAMP collector/app plus ClickHouse 26.11.4.11 and MongoDB 9.0.8
consistency: eventual native query visibility; frozen acknowledged source IDs/selected values must reconcile
durability: OTLP admission precedes native batching/export; ACK survival is an empirical lab gate, not an assumed vendor power-loss promise
atomicity: no cross-signal or whole-batch transaction claim; partial acceptance makes source batch ambiguous
idempotency: not claimed; source never retries automatically; duplicate returned copies fail healthy qualification
delete_ttl: native schema creation defaults to 720h; TTL/reclamation and equal-retention storage comparison unqualified; current corpus is inside every tested retention window
selected_logs: exact body, nanosecond source timestamp, IDs, numeric severity, lowercased native severity text, original logical attributes, resource/scope and flags
selected_metrics: whole-second timestamp, exact gauge value/name/unit/labels, resource/scope and flags
selected_traces: IDs, parent, trace state, scope, service, name/kind/status/message, start/duration, logical attributes, events and links
projection_limits: native log severity text is lowercased
trace main/link flags and log observed-time are absent from this schema
limits: single local compatibility experiment; not an upstream-supported current-dependency guarantee, physical-cold benchmark, native cluster, disk/power-loss, independent restore or production security qualification
